title: LoadingState
description: Page, route and section loading: a decorative ProgressIndicator spinner next to a visible label, inside a single polite status region.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text, which is also what the status region announces

props.name: size
props.description: Minimum height: small for a section, medium for a page or route, large for tall content such as a calendar
